text: Based on the evidence, there is no recent fire activity detected on this rural asset. NASA’s fire-monitoring systems (VIIRS and MODIS) showed zero thermal anomalies within the asset boundaries from October 4 to November 3, 2026. All sensors had full coverage during this period, meaning they would have detected any significant fires. However, small, short-lived, or obscured fires might still have occurred without being picked up. The data does not confirm the absence of burned areas or explain other potential changes (e.g., harvest or clearing). For complete certainty, ground inspection or higher-resolution imagery would be needed.
